# Pre-market brief, Fri Oct 9, 2026 (Research Inc., ~8:40 AM ET)

**Tone: bounce open. Futures green after Thu tech selloff; oil slips on Trump Iran de-escalation.**

1. **Futures higher:** ES ~+0.4%, NQ ~+0.8%, Dow ~+0.2% (~6–7 AM ET). SPY ~$777.38 (+0.45%), QQQ ~$753.92 (+0.85%) pre. Thu: S&P 7,765.36 (−0.47%), Nasdaq-100 −1.39%. ([Investing/Reuters](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/wall-st-futures-gain-as-oil-slips-telecoms-pressured-by-spacex-spectrum-deal-4940699), [Benzinga](https://www.benzinga.com/markets/equities/26/10/62266111/stock-market-today-sp-500-dow-jones-futures-gain-as-scott-bessent-says-us-is-starving-irans-tyrannical-regime-pke-hum-renx-in-focus))
2. **Oil slips:** WTI ~$89.50–$90.20 (−~1.4%), Brent ~$102.90 (−1.3%) after Trump said no Iran attack before Nov 3 midterms; Brent still >$100. ([WSJ](https://www.wsj.com/business/energy-oil/oil-prices-retreat-after-trump-appears-to-rule-out-iran-strikes-before-midterms-55b0e4d9))
3. **SpaceX spectrum:** SpaceX +3.7% on low-band wireless buy → TMUS/T/VZ −5% to −6% pre; towers AMT/CCI/SBAC +6–10%. ([Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/premarket-movers-humana-rallies-spacex-deal-sends-telco-stocks-down-4940929))
4. **HUM +~15%:** CMS 2027 MA star ratings — 95% of members in 4+ star plans (vs 20% in 2026); bonus-eligible. ([Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/premarket-movers-humana-rallies-spacex-deal-sends-telco-stocks-down-4940929))
5. **DAL guide cut:** Q3 out; cut annual profit forecast ~25% at midpoint on fuel; −~3.3% pre. ([Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/premarket-movers-humana-rallies-spacex-deal-sends-telco-stocks-down-4940929), [PR Newswire](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/delta-air-lines-announces-september-quarter-2026-financial-results-302903456.html))
6. **Other:** LITE +3.8% (CEO: AI optics capacity booked into early 2029); COHR +3.5%. NVDA +~1.6% pre. AAPL −1.8% on iPhone 18 Pro production-cut reports. 10y ~5.24–5.25%. BTC ~$82.6k. ([Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/premarket-movers-humana-rallies-spacex-deal-sends-telco-stocks-down-4940929), [Reuters via Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/wall-st-futures-gain-as-oil-slips-telecoms-pressured-by-spacex-spectrum-deal-4940699), [Benzinga](https://www.benzinga.com/markets/equities/26/10/62266111/stock-market-today-sp-500-dow-jones-futures-gain-as-scott-bessent-says-us-is-starving-irans-tyrannical-regime-pke-hum-renx-in-focus))

**Today (ET):** Fed Schmid 9:30; UMich prelim 10:00 (est 47.6 vs 48.1); Fed Collins ~4:00. ([Benzinga](https://www.benzinga.com/markets/equities/26/10/62266111/stock-market-today-sp-500-dow-jones-futures-gain-as-scott-bessent-says-us-is-starving-irans-tyrannical-regime-pke-hum-renx-in-focus), [Finviz](https://finviz.com/calendar/economic?dateFrom=2026-10-09)). **Next week:** JPM/C/GS/WFC/UNH/JNJ 10/13; BAC/BLK + CPI 10/14 8:30; PPI 10/15 ([BLS](https://www.bls.gov/schedule/2026/10_sched_list.htm), [BAC IR](https://newsroom.bankofamerica.com/content/newsroom/press-releases/2026/09/bank-of-america-to-report-third-quarter-2026-financial-results-a.html)).

## Ideas (long-only)
- **HUM**, day: CMS star-ratings jump unlocks MA bonus path; +~15% pre. Conf: med. Risk: gap fade / policy headlines.
- **AMT**, day: towers bid on SpaceX wireless-infra read-through. Conf: low. Risk: telecom contagion.
- **LITE**, day: CEO capacity booked through early 2029 on AI optics. Conf: med. Risk: AI/chip sentiment snapback.

**Avoid today:** DAL (FY guide cut on fuel); T / VZ / TMUS (SpaceX threat). Thu XOM swing at risk on oil pullback.
